Fudbalski klub Tuzla City, formerly known as Fudbalski klub Sloga Simin Han, is a professional football club based in Simin Han, Tuzla, Bosnia and Herzegovina. The club competes in the Second League of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (North), the third tier of football in the country.
